name: Footer
summary: Body-scoped content-info landmark with required target-owned navigation groups, optional brand context, and optional metadata.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native footer landmark scoped to the document body.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Container-responsive composition for brand context and navigation groups.

anatomy.name: brand
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned brand context; it is not a second navigation landmark.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: One or more labelled target-owned navigation groups.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Visible group or brand heading used to label its region where applicable.

anatomy.name: links
anatomy.description: Native list of navigation links for a group.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Native destination link with wrap-safe text and visible interaction states.

anatomy.name: bottom
anatomy.description: Optional metadata row below the navigation groups.

anatomy.name: metadata
anatomy.description: Readable copyright, locale, legal, or brand metadata item.

anatomy.name: metadataLink
anatomy.description: Optional native link inside the metadata row.

states.name: linkHover
states.description: Pointer hover keeps contrast-safe primary text and adds the accent underline.

states.name: linkFocusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus ring around a native footer link.

states.name: wideContainer
states.description: At a 48rem footer container, brand context and three navigation groups share the wider grid.

behavior.name: contentInfoLandmark
behavior.description: Use one body-scoped native footer for the page content-info landmark; do not add a redundant role.

behavior.name: labelledNavigation
behavior.description: Each link group is a nav labelled by its visible heading and contains native list-item links.

behavior.name: containerResponsive
behavior.description: Layout responds to the footer container rather than the document viewport and keeps long localized content contained.

behavior.name: passiveMetadata
behavior.description: Metadata stays ordinary readable content unless a target supplies a genuine destination link.

properties.name: linkGroups
properties.description: One or more target-owned labelled navigation groups with native list-item links.

properties.name: brand
properties.description: Optional target-owned brand heading and supporting context; this does not imply newsletter or social features.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Optional legal, locale, copyright, or brand metadata selected by the target.

accessibility: Use one body-scoped native footer landmark and do not add redundant contentinfo roles.
Label each navigation group from its visible heading and retain native list and link semantics.
Keep link labels and metadata readable, wrap-safe, and operable at the canonical touch target.
Preserve contrast-safe hover, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion, and forced-colors boundaries.
Do not make the footer the only route to critical support actions.

web.notes: Canonical native footer parts, labelled link groups, container query, interaction states, and robust text containment are implemented in components/css/global.css.

shopify.notes: Current Liquid maps brand copy and menu blocks, but modern section-group placement remains an owner-level target decision; newsletter, locale, social, and legal composition are not inferred.
